meta.name: unknown-fields
meta.description: Language-neutral expected verifier outcomes for the unknown-member fixtures. Unknown members in manifest.json, provenance/envelope.json, and chain events MUST be preserved verbatim and included in canonicalization/hashing (spec/manifest.md, spec/envelope.md, spec/chain.md). A verifier that projects these documents onto a fixed schema and re-serializes the projection for hashing drops the members, diverges from the signed bytes, and fails the positive vector here.
meta.no_warranty: Conformance fixtures only; not production templates or advice.

vectors.name: unknown-fields-clean
vectors.note: x- extension members in manifest, envelope, and chain event, all present at seal time and covered by manifest_hash, the envelope signature, and the event hash.

vectors.name: tampered-unknown-manifest-field
vectors.note: The manifest's x-acme-policy value was mutated post-seal; the recomputed manifest_hash must diverge from the signed envelope.manifest_hash.

vectors.name: tampered-unknown-envelope-field
vectors.note: The envelope's x-acme-attestation value was mutated post-seal; the signature over JCS(envelope minus signers) must no longer verify.

vectors.name: tampered-unknown-event-field
vectors.note: The first event's x-acme-review-ticket value was mutated post-seal; the event hash must no longer recompute, and chain/events.jsonl is covered by the content index.
